text.en: The first Academy Awards presentation was held on May 16, 1929, with about 270 people.
text.es: La primera edición de los Óscar se celebró el 16 de mayo de 1929 con cerca de 270 invitados.

text.en: The second ceremony, in 1930, was the first Oscars event to be broadcast by radio.

text.en: The first Academy Awards were held on May 16, 1929, and the ceremony ran for 15 minutes.
